description: This file defines the 'wsdl' class, a PHP class for parsing, handling, and serializing WSDL (Web Services Description Language) files within a SOAP client library, specifically related to NuSOAP. It includes methods for fetching WSDL documents, parsing XML, managing schema types, and generating WSDL descriptions.

classes.name: wsdl
classes.description: A class for parsing, representing, and serializing WSDL files used for SOAP web services. It manages internal representations of schemas, messages, portTypes, bindings, and services, providing methods to access operation details, generate WSDL XML, and handle complex type definitions.

methods.name: fetchWSDL
methods.description: Fetches and parses a WSDL document from a URL or file path.

methods.name: getOperations
methods.description: Returns an array of available operations for a specified port.

methods.name: getOperationData
methods.description: Returns configuration details for a specified operation and binding type.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the internal WSDL representation back into WSDL XML format.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Sets HTTP credentials for accessing protected WSDL URLs.

methods.name: getBindingData
methods.description: Retrieves binding data for a given binding name.

methods.name: getTypeDef
methods.description: Gets the detailed type definition for a given XML schema type.

methods.name: webDescription
methods.description: Generates an HTML page describing the web service operations.

methods.name: serializeType
methods.description: Serializes a PHP value into an XML element based on the specified type, including handling of complex and simple types, attributes, arrays, and encoding styles.

methods.name: serializeComplexTypeAttributes
methods.description: Serializes attributes for a complex XML schema type, including handling of extension base types and attribute defaults.

methods.name: serializeComplexTypeElements
methods.description: Serializes the elements for a complex XML schema type, including nested complex types, arrays, and optional elements.

methods.name: addComplexType
methods.description: Adds a complex type definition to the WSDL types, expanding nested elements and attributes, and supporting various complex type configurations.

methods.name: addSimpleType
methods.description: Adds a simple type (restriction or enumeration) to the WSDL types.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds an element declaration to the WSDL types based on provided attributes.

methods.name: addOperation
methods.description: Registers a new SOAP operation, generating necessary message and portType entries, including support for document style and handling of input/output message parts.
